Edit the FIRST attached image, an actual Q9D game screenshot at viewport width 320px, into a COMPOSITE CONCEPT MOCKUP showing clearer Ascension VFX. The SECOND image is motif/art guide ONLY: Q9D four-row VFX concept draft. Preserve EXACT screenshot width, height, HUD text and borders, touch controls or desktop controls, dark floor texture, all24 enemy bodies/HP/Rupture pips, Player position/scale/identity, camera, and gameplay footprint. Do not redesign or redraw the UI. No labels or captions inside game. Pixel art with crisp intentional highlights, dark under-edge and sparse broken obsidian-metal/ivory details. Match existing Fractured Geometry style and mint P0Player. It must look like the same screenshot with only the specified local effects replaced, no global relighting.

Find two thin hazard circles: the ROSE circle on the RIGHT of Player is PULSE with radius48worldpx. Replace its thin plain ring/cross with a clear rose dashed perimeter on the exact SAME circle, TWO concentric sparse ripple arcs INSIDE that circle (not concentric hitboxes), two small bright ivory split-scar glyphs just OUTSIDE top/bottom. No lightning/cracks/4Anomalycornerbrackets. Maintain rose prepare state, do not turn the whole zone into a yellow blast. A tiny gold imminent progress accent may trace perimeter only. Player is outside Pulse, must remain unobscured. Keep the zone center and radius exactly where the old circle was.

The GOLD circle UP-LEFT of Player is WARDEN ECHO pending at old Player position, radius52worldpx. Replace plain gold outline/cross with a distinctive sparse FLAT chain-link rim on the exact SAME circular footprint, 3-prong Warden crown glyph small in the center, TWO small ivory opposite split-scar source glyphs just outside its boundary. Gold imminent state. Not ripple/bolt/groundfissures/nestedEchoChamberarcs. Do not add a Boss or change any enemy: this is an injected visual stress fixture for review, not a natural encounter. No chain beam to Player. Keep enemies drawn OVER the floor glyph; don't hide their HP/body/windup cues. No warning beyond exact footprint.

Find the tiny upside-down GOLD TRIANGLE above ONE Grunt BELOW and slightly RIGHT of Player. Replace ONLY this old tiny triangle with a compact gold split-eye crest from Hunter row in the guide, thin dark backing and two short side prongs, readable at actual game scale about18-22worldpx wide and smaller than enemy body. Float it clearly above HP/pips; keep all pips and HP. No extra crest on any other enemy, no enemy palette swap or body changes. This is warning state; do not add move trails here.

At PLAYER feet add exactly TWO tiny rose split-scar ticks, one each side below the body (penalty active). Their combined width must be no more than Player body width; retain all mint silhouette and Rupture-related pips. This is status feedback, not another circular hazard, no cyan shield. NO proc bolt/beam/projectile since no Static Riposte hit is happening in this screenshot. Do not invent damage text, new timer/resources/hit marks, clones, incoming arrows, trajectory lines or extra target selection.
